title: Tiny, cute crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='moonBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFD740'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='moonShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFCA28'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFA000'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- crescent moon main body: big circle minus offset circle -->
  <path d='M50 8
           A42 42 0 1 0 50 92
           A34 34 0 1 1 50 8 Z'
        fill='url(#moonBody)'/>

  <!-- inner shadow crescent for depth -->
  <path d='M62 18
           A38 38 0 1 1 62 82
           A30 30 0 1 0 62 18 Z'
        fill='url(#moonShade)' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- highlight on the moon edge -->
  <path d='M44 16
           A36 36 0 0 1 56 20
           A32 32 0 0 0 44 26 Z'
        fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- cute face: two eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#3E2723'/>

  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='42.5' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='40.5' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.65'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.65'/>

  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M38 54
           Q43 59 48 54'
        stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
